name: Config for the Bren mod
_comment_spawnCasingParticles: Spawns empty casings when a gun is fired
_comment_recoilMultiplier: The recoil multiplier, so 0 is no recoil || Default: 0.5
_comment_machineGunDamage: Ranged damage for the Machine Gun || Default: 4.0
_comment_netheriteMachineGunDamage: Ranged damage for the Netherite Machine Gun || Default: 5.0
_comment_autoGunDamage: Ranged damage for the Auto-Gun || Default: 6.0
_comment_netheriteAutoGunDamage: Ranged damage for the Netherite Auto-Gun || Default: 6.5
_comment_rifleDamage: Ranged damage for the Rifle || Default: 10.0
_comment_netheriteRifleDamage: Ranged damage for the Netherite Rifle || Default: 11.0
_comment_shotgunDamage: Damage per shrapnel for the Shotgun || Default: 3.5
_comment_netheriteShotgunDamage: Damage per shrapnel for the Netherite Shotgun || Default: 3.75
_comment_revolverDamage: Ranged damage for the Revolver || Default: 8.0
_comment_netheriteRevolverDamage: Ranged damage for the Netherite Revolver || Default: 9.0
_comment_machineGunDurability: Shots before the Machine Gun breaks || Default: 100
_comment_netheriteMachineGunDurability: Shots before the Netherite Machine Gun breaks || Default: 150
_comment_autoGunDurability: Shots before the Auto-Gun breaks || Default: 90
_comment_netheriteAutoGunDurability: Shots before the Netherite Auto-Gun breaks || Default: 135
_comment_rifleDurability: Shots before the Rifle breaks || Default: 80
_comment_netheriteRifleDurability: Shots before the Netherite Rifle breaks || Default: 120
_comment_shotgunDurability: Shots before the Shotgun breaks || Default: 40
_comment_netheriteShotgunDurability: Shots before the Netherite Shotgun breaks || Default: 60
_comment_revolverDurability: Shots before the Revolver breaks || Default: 50
_comment_netheriteRevolverDurability: Shots before the Netherite Revolver breaks || Default: 75
_comment_flameDurabilityPenalty: Extra durability lost per shot for each level of Flame on the weapon (on top of the normal 1) || Default: 1
_comment_allMobsAttackPlayers: Makes all mobs hostile towards players
_comment_supplyCrateSpawnChance: Supply crate spawn chance (1 in X chunks)
_comment_minGunsPerCrate: Minimum number of guns per supply crate
_comment_maxGunsPerCrate: Maximum number of guns per supply crate
_comment_minAmmoTypesPerCrate: Minimum number of ammo types per supply crate
_comment_maxAmmoTypesPerCrate: Maximum number of ammo types per supply crate
_comment_minMagazinesPerCrate: Minimum number of magazines per supply crate
_comment_maxMagazinesPerCrate: Maximum number of magazines per supply crate
